One year ago today...still no accountability. 

Passing legislation in her name and as a reactive measure would probably feel better if and only if the Louisville police who murdered Breonna Taylor were held accountable.

Artist: @asherald ✊🏾

#BreonnaTaylor #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/6bcGImM3FY

I often wonder what a day would feel like when there isn't any violence, death, abuse, harassment, micro-aggressions, white supremacy, etc....

On this day, I hope to say, "This is what true happiness feels like."

#StopAsianHate #BlackLivesMatter #DestroyWhiteSupremacy
